_note: Interaction-coverage ratchet, read by scripts/interactions.mjs. A library with no spec is reported as UNCOVERED, not as a failure — five of eight are uncovered today and a permanently-red command is a command nobody reads. What IS a failure is dropping below these numbers: a deleted spec, or a demo losing its only check. Raise them when you add coverage; lower them only deliberately, and say why in the commit.
